'''Mason Simpson''' was a mathematics professor at [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] [[Salis D'aar Academy|Academy]]. He was consulted by [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] who was researching the [[Ssi-ruu]]k for the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. Simpson was tall, causing him to stoop, and he enjoyed telling stories.
